<b>Styx</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Once saved, he supplies [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] with [[Silkeater|Silkeaters]].

== Background ==
Styx lives in a secluded room in [[Sinner's Road]]. He believes the strong claim the weak, and that the weak must serve.<ref>Styx: <i>"No... the sss-strong claim the weak, and the weak must sss-ssserve!"</i></ref> As such, he is looking for somebody strong to protect him and eagerly wants to become their slave.<ref>Styx: <i>"You have come to claim me, and I am yourssss. I am your humble sss-ssslave! (...) I am yoursss, my mistress, and you muss-sst protect me!"</i></ref> He built a Silkeater nest to provide food for a powerful future master.<ref>Styx: <i>"Sss-ssee what I have built here! Prepared, for the coming of my mistressss. My powerful missssss-tress! (...) A ss-sslave must feed his misstress-sss. Morsss-sels will I grow."</i></ref> Above the nest, he has a room with different bug masks, including one identical to the one he is wearing. 

== In-game Events ==
Styx is located at the far east edge of the room at the lowest level of Sinner's Road. 

Initially, there are 2 [[Muckroach|Muckroaches]] barking at the ceiling near Styx's location. After [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] defeats them, the room shakes, and a nearby bench becomes interactable. After Hornet sits down on the bench, Styx descends from the ceiling. He assigns Hornet as his mistress and vows to serve her as a slave.<ref><i>"Farewell...? No... the sss-strong claim the weak, and the weak must sss-ssserve! I am yoursss, my mistress, and you muss-sst protect me!"</i></ref>

After this point, he grows one Silkeater per hour that can be collected after they have grown. Only one fully-grown Silkeater is available at a time. 30 minutes after taking the Silkeater he can be seen tending to a growing Silkeater cocoon.

If Styx is not in his nest, Hornet can call him back by playing the [[Needolin]] or pressing the [[Controls (Silksong)|CHALLENGE]] button.

A delivery of a [[Queen's Egg]] from [[Bellhart]] to Styx can be given by [[Tipp & Pill]]. When this delivery is completed, Styx's nest expands and allows him to hold up to 2 Silkeaters, and he gives Hornet {{R|260}}, or {{R|290}} if done in [[Act 3]]. This delivery cannot be repeated.

In Act 3 Styx must be saved again from 2 [[Void Mass]]es which appear in his room and also temporarily disable the [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]]. These Void Masses replace the Muckroaches if this is Hornet's first encounter with Styx. The Queen's Egg delivery Wish cannot be completed unless Styx has been rescued from the Void Masses.
{{Steel Soul Header|SS}}
In [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], Styx is found dead in the collapsed remains of his nest. He is replaced by [[Skynx]] who is found behind a breakable wall to the right of Styx's room.

== Location ==
Styx can be found at the far east edge of the room at the lowest level of [[Sinner's Road]].

There is a secret room that can be found by using the Silk Soar ability underneath Styx.
